footer: SardiniaFestival · The whole island, one calendar.

verification.subject: Verify your SardiniaFestival account
verification.heading: Confirm your email
verification.greeting: Hello {name}, confirm your email address to activate your SardiniaFestival account.
verification.expiry: This link is valid for 24 hours. If you did not create an account, you can ignore this email.

passwordReset.subject: Reset your SardiniaFestival password
passwordReset.heading: Choose a new password
passwordReset.intro: We received a request to reset your password. This link is valid for one hour.
passwordReset.ignore: If you did not request it, you can ignore this email.

eventReceived.subject: We received “{eventTitle}”
eventReceived.heading: Thank you for sharing your event.
eventReceived.greeting: Hello {name}, we received your submission for “{eventTitle}”.
eventReceived.review: Our editorial review is underway. We will let you know when the event status changes.

eventPublished.subject: “{eventTitle}” is live
eventPublished.heading: Your event is live.
eventPublished.greeting: Hello {name}, “{eventTitle}” has been reviewed and is now on the SardiniaFestival calendar.

eventRejected.subject: An update on “{eventTitle}”
eventRejected.heading: Your submission has been updated.
eventRejected.greeting: Hello {name}, your submission for “{eventTitle}” was not approved for publication. You can contact us to add information or correct the details.
